explication: Seed-VC provides zero-shot voice, singing-voice, and real-time conversion, plus V2 style conversion and custom-data fine-tuning. The main workflow takes source speech and a target voice reference through a selected model runtime and produces converted audio. The graph separates V1/V2 inference, shared audio and model components, interfaces, and training. Some UI and training details are represented from documented capabilities and the file tree; their internal wiring is not asserted where source excerpts do not show it.
